query:
-- Duplicate bookings: same delegate + same sponsor more than once
SELECT 
  s.companyName,
  m.attendeeId,
  COUNT(*) as booking_count,
  GROUP_CONCAT(m.timeSlot ORDER BY m.timeSlot) as slots
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m.sponsorId
WHERE m.isVisible = 1
GROUP BY m.sponsorId, m.attendeeId
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY booking_count DESC;
